facts.claim: Plugin file ~/.config/amp/plugins/<name>.ts (system) or .amp/plugins/*.ts (project), run by Bun, default export function (amp: PluginAPI); reload with 'plugins: reload'
Hook: amp.on('tool.call', (event: ToolCallEvent, ctx) => ToolCallResult | Promise<ToolCallResult>); request events must return a result; order across plugins undefined
Payload: toolUseID, tool, input, thread.id; no cwd or session field beyond thread id, no MCP server field
Results: allow; reject-and-continue {message}; modify {input} (rewrite); synthesize {result:{output, exitCode?}}; error {message} stops the thread worker

No ask result; asking is done inside the handler with await ctx.ui.confirm({title, message}) -> boolean; dismissed resolves false; throws (isPluginUINotAvailableError) when no UI, e.g. amp -x or code_exec in a subagent; endTurnOnDecline ignored in hooks
